method: Complete reads of four pinned blobs; Git/SHA256 verified. Original _set_visible_child executed with synthetic stack and signal-capable child; no Gtk runtime.
findings: View switch activates new child and emits view-enter before emitting old view-leave. Only TypeError is caught; missing previous child raises AttributeError after new-enter. Synthetic control confirms behavior, normal Gtk startup reachability unproven.

Index navigation clamps to stack bounds but assumes nonempty stack; switch(name) assumes requested child exists. Search-mode delegation assumes active view supports method. These are caller preconditions, not independently tested UI guarantees.
Main window wires settings/about/search/default-action/quit and toggle-search, with header widgets added/removed by views. It provides no extra scan-completeness validation at presentation boundary.

CSS defines indicator colors/progress/location selection styles; manifest embeds CSS and SVG under fixed resource prefix. Empty views package initializer has no behavior. Reading styles/manifest does not qualify layout or icon pixels; SVG visual inspection remains outstanding.

executed_control.scope: Synthetic stack only; normal Gtk startup reachability not established.

limits: No rendered UI, navigation end-to-end or graphics verification.
